manifest.name: temporal-tests
manifest.description: Every top-level test of the Temporal ./tests package, generated from its test list

workload.invariant: passes through the one-box cluster under virtual time

TestClientMiscTestSuite.reason: Its choice tape overflows the 64 MiB bound on both seeds (choice_trace_overflow, darwin/arm64 2026-09-28); seed repeatability is proven without a retained success replay.

TestScheduleV1.reason: Its choice tape overflows the 64 MiB bound (choice_trace_overflow, darwin/arm64 2026-09-29); seed repeatability is proven without a retained success replay.

TestScheduleV1WorkflowPauseInteraction.reason: Its choice tape overflows the 64 MiB bound (choice_trace_overflow, darwin/arm64 2026-09-29); seed repeatability is proven without a retained success replay.

TestStartDelay/UpdateWhilePaused_AfterWi.reason: Under the forward clock tick a deadline propagated over gRPC lands a few microseconds later on the server than on the client, because time.Now runs ahead of the timer clock by the accumulated draws; the 3s long poll then hits the client's context deadline before the server returns its empty response (seed 11; seed 17 passes). The suite runs under forward because that removes eleven timestamp-tie skips.

TestVersioningFunctionalSuite.reason: Its choice tape overflows the 64 MiB bound (choice_trace_overflow, darwin/arm64 2026-09-29); seed repeatability is proven without a retained success replay. Its WAL-mode SQLite database grows past 16 MiB, which the in-memory filesystem refused until 2026-09-29; with the raised bound a repetition runs the whole suite in about 20 minutes of wall time on darwin/arm64, so it needs the longer budgets. With the D25 corrections (enhanced DescribeTaskQueue cache keyed by report flags; TestDescribeTaskQueueEnhanced_ReportFlags waits for the poller under both task-queue types) it qualifies on seeds 11 and 17 (darwin/arm64 2026-09-30); linux/amd64 was not run.

TestSignalWorkflowTestSuiteChasm.reason: Carried the darwin replay divergence fixed under F10 D14 (2026-09-30): a contended scheduler lock drew from the seeded runtime stream, a type-assertion cache grew on a different call, and two heap-span refills swapped order. It keeps the 64 MiB choice trace and success replay that routine workloads no longer record, because an untraced run cannot observe a replay divergence; darwin/arm64 is expected to qualify with exact replay, and linux/amd64 stays intermittent until F10 D12 is verified there.

TestTaskQueueStats_Pri_Suite.reason: Its cluster outgrows the 64 MiB I/O transcript and the 64 MiB choice-trace maximum; with a 512 MiB transcript and no choice trace it qualifies on seeds 11 and 17 (darwin/arm64 2026-09-30), proving same-seed repeatability without a retained exact-replay artifact.

TestVersioning3QueryFunctionalSuite.reason: Its cluster outgrows the 64 MiB I/O transcript and the 64 MiB choice-trace maximum; with a 512 MiB transcript and no choice trace it qualifies on seeds 11 and 17 (darwin/arm64 2026-09-30), proving same-seed repeatability without a retained exact-replay artifact.

TestWorkerDeploymentSuite.reason: Its cluster outgrows the 64 MiB I/O transcript and the 64 MiB choice-trace maximum; with a 512 MiB transcript and no choice trace it qualifies on seeds 11 and 17 (darwin/arm64 2026-09-30), proving same-seed repeatability without a retained exact-replay artifact.

TestVersioning3FunctionalSuite.reason: Its cluster outgrows a 512 MiB I/O transcript and the 64 MiB choice-trace maximum; with the 1 GiB transcript maximum and no choice trace it qualifies on seeds 11 and 17 (darwin/arm64 2026-09-30), proving same-seed repeatability without a retained exact-replay artifact.
